text:
Sara: Heads-up: planning a controlled rollout for release 0.9.2 on Tue 2026-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC. I want quick sanity checks on the internal blurb, ops checklist, and pin strategy. Will pin the internal announce in #eng once we have :thumbsup: from ops/platform/docs by 18:00 UTC today.

Michael: quick read looks fine. Please call out known risk: potential p95 regressions on very long contexts (>8k). I can word that sentence more clearly if you want.

Kevin: Regarding pinning, prefer this sequence: pin hosted API to `0.9.2-rc3` for canary, then switch to `0.9.2` on full. That gives us a clear rollback window to `0.9.1`. Is that feasible?

Ashley: Rollback path validated in staging. Our plan: if canary breaches thresholds, ops will pin to `0.9.1-hotfix` and route traffic back. Rollback snippet below (tested):

```
# ops rollback to previous pinned model
./scripts/pin_model --env=prod --model=0.9.1-hotfix --actor=ashley --reason="rollback from 0.9.2"
```

Ashley: Note: do not run any DB migrations during the canary. We need a migration freeze 30m before the first canary step.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @Sara for 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. Canary steps: 5% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100%. Health gates: sustained 5xx > 3/min for 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m triggers auto-rollback. Notifying #eng-oncall and #eng-sre during rollout.

platform-oncall: Affirm migration freeze. Also request that any infra/config flags be listed in the release notes and PR links included so we can pre-approve. I'll be watching the infra dashboards.

Olivia: I'll expand the external release notes after the internal gets pinned. Reminder to include a short 'impact on customers' blurb and the KV cache behavior change.

Henry: I'll stand up a short-lived release dashboard (Console -> Releases -> 0.9.2) with per-route p95 + tokens/req so SRE can monitor cost regressions. Will have it ready Mon 09:00 UTC.

Sara: Draft internal blurb (keeping it concise for the internal announcement):

---
Redwood Inference 0.9.2 (planned Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC)
- Rollout: staged canary (small % -> full); automatic rollback on elevated errors/latency.
- Highlights: batching improvements for short-chat workloads; KV cache invalidation fix; quantization parameter tweaks for selected open models.
- Customer impact: expected lower per-token costs for conversational flows; possible transient higher p95 for requests with >8k context during early canary.
- Pinning & rollback: will pin to `0.9.2-rc3` during canary then promote to `0.9.2`. Rollback target is `0.9.1-hotfix`.

Ops quick checklist:
- Migration freeze 30m pre-canary
- Oncall + alerting configured (5xx + p95)
- Rollback command present in /ops/scripts
- Post-rollback: postmortem and customer comms plan if triggered
---

Sara: I plan to post this short internal note to #eng, #product, and #customer-success once you :thumbsup:. Add last-minute callouts here and I'll fold them into the pinned message.

Michael: :thumbsup: good to go.

Kevin: :thumbsup: pin flow acknowledged.

Ashley: Ack 2 test rollback in staging; I'll be oncall for the window.

Olivia: :thumbsup: prepping expanded public notes after internal pin.

Henry: Dashboard ready Monday morning.

Sara: Thanks all 2 pinning the internal copy now and scheduling the deploy job. If anyone spots something after pinning, drop it here and I'll update the pinned message before blast.
